basis.decisions: The owner's draft order of 2026-10-20 commissions this draft only (D-31 will be frozen for execution; this step drafts). No freeze order and no execution order exist for this contract. The freeze coordinator's three Stage-0 flags are disposed of in adjudication.md section 3 (DD-038-1 mechanical verdict rule, no pre-written outcome; DD-038-9 cluster-class operationalisation; DD-038-5 named sources and conflict rule). DD-038-6 is an open proposal for the freeze decision (file the frozen spec's own OSF contract registration). The contract implemented is design D-31 (PR #195) for the PRED-2026-007 registration (docs/PREDICTION_REGISTER.md, registered 2026-04-22).

design.registered_prediction: Signs with ICIT function code ITM will cluster into TERMINAL class in CGSA Phase 5 at rate >= 70%.

criterion.verbatim: >= 70% of ITM-coded signs are TERMINAL or cluster in TERMINAL clusters
criterion.verdict_rule: mechanical: the share of enumerated ITM signs counting as TERMINAL over the denominator the coverage rule fixes, against the 70% bar; CONFIRMED at or above, NOT CONFIRMED below; no band; no pre-written outcome for any branch (DD-038-1)
criterion.recorded_partial_test: P385 (ITM) Cluster 21 TERMINAL; P378 (ITM) Cluster 39 TERMINAL; P098 (LOG) Cluster 10 INITIAL; recorded rate 2/3 (67%) - a pre-execution record whose denominator mixed in a non-ITM sign; outcome PARTIALLY CONFIRMED

population.frame: every distinct sign whose function code in the primary source is exactly ITM; no sample, no frequency threshold, no attestation requirement
population.excluded_by_rule: P098 (LOG) and every sign coded other than ITM, or uncoded
population.status_at_draft: NOT enumerated: membership and size are execution-time facts (step 0, check 0.2)

sources.conflict_rule: the primary governs membership; every cross-check disagreement is recorded sign-by-sign and published; ambiguity or internal conflict within the primary closes the study as CANNOT BE RUN AS WRITTEN (DD-038-5)
sources.provenance_lineage: backend/glossa_lab/data/fuls_parser.py reads the function codes (NUM, LON, SHN, TMK, ITM, LOG, SYL) from Wells-derived catalog lines; the register's 'from mayig features' line is reconciled by appended note, never edited (DD-038-2)

phase5_output.cluster_class_rule: DD-038-9 (disclosed operationalisation): a cluster's class is the class recorded for that cluster in reports/cluster_characterization.md (sha256 54ebf660873fd853a64ce91c7e30d8c4cedc5bc3a0a1555db1f6281a52e3c476); no recorded rule assigning classes to clusters has been located; no class is derived from rates at execution; a cluster with no recorded class leaves its signs unassigned under the coverage rule
phase5_output.corroboration: reports/cgsa_validation_report.md (2026-04-22): best k 40, largest cluster 12/160, entropy reduction 0.3204
phase5_output.no_reclustering: scoring reads the recorded output only; if it does not survive in sign-assignable form the study closes as CANNOT BE RUN AS WRITTEN; a fresh clustering is a new prediction's business

order: sources and provenance (primary and cross-check verified and hashed; conflict rule in force; reconciliation note drafted for append)
enumeration (mechanical read of the primary's icit_function field over all 611 records; record-count reconciliation; cross-check run; the enumeration written and hashed before any Phase 5 lookup)
Phase 5 output verification (recorded output in sign-assignable form; the sanity anchor reproduced)
step0.failure_closure: CANNOT BE RUN AS WRITTEN, unscored, reported as a closure and never as a verdict; the census branch is a completion, not a closure

coverage_rule.denominator: the assigned population when some enumerated signs have no recorded Phase 5 assignment, with coverage stated in the verdict's first sentence
coverage_rule.decisiveness_exception: if the unassigned signs cannot change the outcome arithmetically, the verdict is decisive and coverage is still stated
coverage_rule.below_floor: coverage below 80% and not arithmetically decisive: the appended entry records the test as run-at-partial-scope with the numbers
coverage_rule.provenance: the design's rule (D-31), not the register's (DD-038-4)

design.census_branch: if the enumerated population is exactly the ITM signs already tested, the design closes with the census as its finding: a completion, scored by the mechanical verdict rule; no outcome is pre-written for this branch (DD-038-1)
design.register_handling: dated section 6 appends only (the outcome entry and the provenance reconciliation note); the registered section 3 text is never edited; every other prediction's entry stays byte-identical; on a step-0 closure the section 3 Outcome stays PARTIALLY CONFIRMED as the pre-execution record
